d: THE HOLLOW CIRCUIT #1 — Ghosts of Sector Nine. Rherine spots it first: scorch marks in a perfect ring, at the edge of Sector Nine rooftops. Starring Olrine (Galston Delglen), Rherine (Ibex Belglen), Sylrakia (Luhal Shamere). Neon-row couriers who dive the city's ghost frequencies discover a signal that was never meant to be heard.
